class.name: InterDVDEditorPlugin
class.brief_description: Registers the Interactive DVD export platform.
class.description: Adds [EditorExportPlatformWindowsInterDVD] and Project → Tools → Create Interactive DVD Scene. Disc, title, and menu inspectors add [InterDVDTitle], [InterDVDChapter], [InterDVDMenuPage], and [InterDVDHotspot] nodes. There is no play-in-editor disc player.
